ProcessPage.title: How we work
ProcessPage.description: Explore how KONDAX reviews your workflow, prototypes a focused build and supports improvements after launch.
ProcessPage.og_description: Define a priority problem, test a small working version and agree on development scope, cost, delivery and operations.

intro.title: Test a focused build in your real workflow.
intro.description: Connect discovery, prototyping and improvement after launch. Review the work with the people who will use it and clarify the features they need. Agree on scope, costs and delivery before work begins.

discover.title: Understand the work and the problem
discover.p1: Tell us your current difficulties and goals. We review your tasks and tools, with an on-site workflow review where needed.
discover.p2: Review time spent on reports, duplicate data entry and handoffs that get delayed. Use the available information to decide what to address first.
discover.p3: Our proposal sets out the development scope, cost and assumptions behind the expected impact. Review integration constraints and operational considerations before deciding what to build.

tasks.title: What we review at this stage
tasks.i2: Time and cost of current tasks
tasks.i4: Difficulties for the people using it
tasks.i5: Scope to test in a prototype

build.title: Prototype, build and review
build.p1: Prototype the priority features so your team can try them. Review usability and gaps in the workflow to clarify what is needed for launch.
build.p2: If requirements change, review the effect on cost and delivery before proceeding. Agree on which features to add now and which to consider later.
build.p3: Review working software and test results throughout development. The frequency and format of progress updates are agreed to fit the project and your team.

values.title: What you can review during development

i3.body: Use the prototype and review results to decide whether to develop further.

i4.body: Test a focused scope to identify usability and integration issues before launch.

deliver.title: Launch, operate and improve
deliver.p1: Plan testing and a limited rollout to fit the effect on your operations. Review the required data and procedures, then launch when the team is prepared.
deliver.p2: Agree on the support scope and contact methods before launch. Monitoring, incident response and support hours are defined for the system and the people operating it.
deliver.p3: Review the measures agreed for the project, such as task duration or duplicate entries, before and after launch. Identify improvements and estimate the scope and cost of further work.

YadoraPage.title: Yadora | Hospitality CRM, AI Marketing & PMS Case Study | KONDAX
YadoraPage.description: A KONDAX case study for Yadora, an integrated hospitality platform covering Wi-Fi QR guest capture, CRM, AI campaigns, direct booking, reservations, guest registers and housekeeping.

intro.description: Guest relationships begin with a simple QR code in the room. With consent, contact details become a growing guest list; AI prepares campaigns and coupons, while the next stay can be booked directly without per-booking commission. Marketing, reservations, guest registers and housekeeping run as one connected operation.
intro.imageAlt: The Yadora website hero introducing its hospitality CRM and AI marketing concept

ai.title: Recommended action
ai.description: A returning-guest campaign is ready for an upcoming open period.

challenge.title: Every booking sent profit and customer relationships elsewhere.
challenge.description: OTAs are powerful acquisition channels, but commissions compound as bookings grow and the relationship with each guest rarely remains with the property after checkout. For small teams already busy with reservations and housekeeping, consistent retention marketing was structurally difficult.

item1.title: OTA fees compress margins
item1.description: Sales commissions are commonly 10–20% of the stay. As bookings grow, that cost keeps weighing on profit.

item2.title: Guest relationships do not stay
item2.description: Without a direct way to invite guests back, the property has to pay to meet the same customer again.

item3.title: Retention work never reaches the top
item3.description: Daily reservations and housekeeping come first, leaving little time to create and manage recurring campaigns.

flow.title: Place it. Grow it. Bring them back.
flow.description: No special hardware or construction. A QR code in the room starts a loop that grows the property’s guest list and direct bookings.

step1.title: Place the QR code in the room
step1.description: Register the property and Wi-Fi details, then print the generated connection QR. Setup takes only minutes.

step2.title: Build a guest list naturally
step2.description: With consent, Wi-Fi access, guest-register details and booking history are organized around each guest profile.

step3.title: Let AI invite guests back
step3.description: AI drafts the segment and message. Approve the campaign and turn a past stay into the next direct booking.

features.title: Collect. Re-engage. Sell direct.
features.description: The core platform turns guest relationships into an asset and runs marketing and day-to-day operations on the same data.

item1.title: Automatic guest-list growth
item1.description: Consented guest data from Wi-Fi access, registers and bookings becomes a unified, cross-property stay history.

item2.title: AI-powered retention marketing
item2.description: AI drafts segments, campaigns and coupons, tracks opens and helps reactivate guests who have not returned.

item3.title: Direct booking website
item3.description: Publish from a template with live availability, rates and Stripe payments—without a per-booking commission.

item4.title: Unified inventory and rates
item4.description: Manage inventory from property to bed across four levels and sync OTA calendars over iCal to prevent double bookings.

item5.title: Encryption and tenant isolation
item5.description: Sensitive Wi-Fi and guest-register data is encrypted and isolated by host to support secure operations.

item6.title: ChatGPT and Claude via MCP
item6.description: Connect familiar AI assistants to availability checks, reservation approvals, campaign creation and other workflows.

operations.title: Not just marketing—the whole back of house.
operations.description: Yadora standardizes the operating work behind every stay so more direct bookings do not create more operational complexity.

item1.title: Mobile check-in and legal register
item1.description: Guests complete the register on their phones while sensitive details are encrypted and organized for compliant records.

item2.title: On-site guides and add-on orders
item2.description: Bring property information, additional services and time-based requests into the guest’s phone.

item3.title: Multilingual AI chat
item3.description: An AI trained on the property answers guest questions across languages and reduces late-night support load.

item4.title: Staff, housekeeping and payroll
item4.description: Share permission-based tasks, checklists and photo reports, then roll housekeeping rewards into payroll totals.

results.title: Turn value lost to commissions into margin and customer equity.
results.description: A monthly model with no per-booking commission. As the direct-booking mix grows, more profit and more guest relationships remain with the property.

cta.title: Start growing your guest list with the next check-in.
cta.description: Explore Yadora’s features, pricing and onboarding on the official website. For product development or a similar operational platform, talk to KONDAX.

BockerPage.title: Bocker | Salon Booking & Customer Management SaaS Case Study | KONDAX
BockerPage.description: A KONDAX case study for Bocker, a salon platform integrating 24/7 booking, slot optimization, digital client records, customer and revenue management, and LINE notifications.

intro.description: Online booking, staff and menu management, treatment records, points, coupons and revenue analytics come together in one workspace. Bocker reduces daily checking and re-entry so salon teams can focus on every client and the work that brings them back.
intro.imageAlt: The Bocker website hero showing product screens for booking, customer and revenue management

challenge.title: Work outside the treatment room kept taking time away from clients.
challenge.description: Phone bookings, paper or spreadsheet records and separate revenue reports create constant checking and re-entry. Fragmented information leaves less time for clients and less room to build a deliberate retention practice.

item1.title: Booking coordination interrupts the day
item1.description: Every availability check breaks the flow of a treatment, while bookings outside business hours can be missed entirely.

item2.title: Customer history is hard to use
item2.description: When treatments, photos and notes live in different places, preparation and staff handoffs take longer than they should.

item3.title: Revenue does not reveal the next action
item3.description: When booking, menu and customer data are separate, popular services and repeat-visit patterns are difficult to act on quickly.

flow.title: One continuous record from booking to the next visit.
flow.description: A booking becomes the starting point for client records, checkout, points and analytics—all connected to the same customer profile.

step1.title: Accept bookings around the clock
step1.description: Offer availability based on staff, services and duration so customers can book even while the salon team is busy.

step2.title: Build the client record at every visit
step2.description: Organize treatment details, photos, notes and purchase history by customer and keep the next staff handoff clear.

step3.title: Use the data to bring clients back
step3.description: Turn booking and revenue history into useful insight, then stay connected through LINE, points and coupons.

features.title: Everything a salon needs, without a maze of tools.
features.description: A straightforward interface follows the salon’s real workflow while one data foundation connects bookings, customers and revenue.

item1.title: Smart booking management
item1.description: Manage 24/7 online booking, availability, staff assignments and services from one reservation timeline.

item2.title: Automatic slot optimization
item2.description: Generate bookable slots around staff, duration and concurrent-booking rules for each salon’s operation.

item3.title: Digital client records
item3.description: Keep treatment history, hair or skin condition, photos and notes together for faster preparation and handoffs.

item4.title: Staff and menu management
item4.description: Update permissions, shifts, services, pricing, duration and add-ons from the same operating workspace.

item5.title: Points and coupons
item5.description: Create loyalty rules connected to visit history and give each customer a reason to book the next appointment.

item6.title: Revenue and customer analytics
item6.description: See daily, service and staff revenue alongside customer behavior to support the next business decision.

operations.title: More than a booking book—the salon’s daily operating layer.
operations.description: The customer booking experience and the staff management workspace stay connected through the same information.

item1.title: Bookings and visits
item1.description: Review the day’s appointments and open slots on a timeline and share each status from arrival through checkout.

item2.title: Customer portal
item2.description: Give customers access to their booking history, profile and points through a dedicated personal view.

item3.title: LINE reminders
item3.description: Deliver appointment reminders and salon updates through LINE, a familiar everyday customer touchpoint.

item4.title: Payments and store operations
item4.description: Bring online payments, revenue visibility and staff permissions into the same operational platform.

results.title: Give management time back to service and growth.
results.description: Bocker removes the work of stitching booking, records and retention tools together, helping small salon teams deliver a consistent customer experience.

cta.title: Make salon operations simpler with the next booking.
cta.description: Explore Bocker’s features, pricing and demo on the official website. For a booking, customer management or similar operational product, talk to KONDAX.

faq.label: Before we talk
faq.title: A few questions you may have.

items.question: Can we talk before we know what to build?
items.answer: Yes. Start with a task that is causing trouble, such as entering the same information into several tools. We can review the current workflow together and decide where to begin.

items.question: How are cost and delivery time determined?
items.answer: We estimate after reviewing the required features, integrations and ongoing operations. We can separate an initial test from later development to fit your budget.

items.question: Can we keep the tools we already use?
items.answer: We explore connections with your existing website, LINE, booking or payment tools. We review available APIs and service terms before confirming the integration scope.

items.question: Can you help after the system goes live?
items.answer: Yes. We can discuss maintenance, operations and additional features to fit your system and workflow. The scope and costs are agreed in advance.
